newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast prods talked higher with demand.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast prods talked higher with demand.

text.p: Spot prices for U.S. West Coast products continued rising Monday in a thinly traded market, traders said.
"There's still demand out there," one trader said.
An industry function late Monday took many traders out of the market, and kept the number of completed deals low.
A September parcel for Los Angeles CARB unleaded gasoline was heard sold to a trade house from a refiner at 74.25 cents a gallon.
Fourth-cycle August barrels were talked between 79 and 80 cents a gallon in Los Angeles, up one cent from Friday, and putting the roll to September at 5.00 cents.
San Francisco barrels were pegged two cents under L.A., while diesel and jet fuel were talked at levels equal to L.A. supplies.
